item.title: Individual Project
item.description: Individual Project # This is your own project, separate from the team project. Use one individual GitHub Pages website throughout the semester and register its link in ML Class Hub. Update the same website at midterm and final; do not create a new link for each checkpoint. The course-specific Hub assignment will identify the required dataset, label mappings, and submission details once staff configure it. CIFAR-10 is an example, not a required dataset.

item.title: Team Proposal
item.description: Team Project Proposal # Submit a concise proposal on your team’s existing project website and register the website link and team in ML Class Hub by the date on the course schedule. Keep using this site through midterm and final; no separate proposal website is needed. This milestone is for the team project, not the individual project. Choose the question # Start with a real problem that your team can investigate within one semester.

item.title: Team Midterm Review
item.description: Team Midterm Website Review and TA Meeting # Update the same team project website before your scheduled TA meeting. The meeting is the team midterm checkpoint. There is no separate team midterm report or video, and the individual project’s video is a different requirement. The course schedule gives the two-week review window; arrange the meeting with your assigned TA through the course process. Show progress, not a finished paper # On the website, state the current question and any change since the proposal; data access and preparation; a working baseline or early experiment if available; evaluation completed so far; honest failures and blockers; each member’s contribution; and the next concrete experiments.

item.title: Team Final Report
item.description: Team Final Report, Website, and TA Interview # The team delivers a paper-style report on the same team website, supporting code and reproduction instructions, and a TA interview. The interview is in the two-week final-review window; the completed website is due on the last instructional day shown in the course schedule. Keep the same ML Class Hub team link. The individual project’s final website and interview are separate; see Individual Project.

item.title: Project TA Meeting
item.description: Project TA Meetings # The current Spring 2027 project-review schedule is explained on the Individual and Team Projects page and the course schedule. This older page is hidden from navigation so it does not duplicate or contradict those instructions.

item.title: Bonus
item.description: Project Bonus # The current Spring 2027 grading plan has no optional project bonus. See Categories for the 100% course-grade breakdown. This older page is hidden from navigation so it does not present obsolete bonus criteria.

item.title: Awards and Examples
item.description: Project Awards and Examples # These awards recognize exceptional individual and team projects. They are distinct from course grades: an award is not needed for full credit, and the current Spring 2027 grading plan does not include extra course-grade points for awards. Every completed project is eligible for consideration; no separate award application is required. The final website and interview are the evidence reviewed. See Grading Categories for the course-grade weights.
